rules: Upload and access grants are short-lived, server-bound and never expose object credentials, permanent URLs or client-selected authority facts.
Media publish eligibility requires READY and CLEAN source media, valid rights and an official subtitle or text alternative; unknown or stale facts deny publication and delivery.
MediaManifest is metadata-only and contains exactly one TEXT_ALTERNATIVE and one PRACTICE_ALTERNATIVE with explicit availability reasons.
Adult remote voice recording requires the dedicated IAM-derived VOICE_RECORDING consent purpose and version; microphone denial preserves silent practice and never fabricates remote success.
Only assessment-service owns shadowing session, attempt and rule result facts; media-service owns the recording asset and learning-service consumes only trusted assessment results.
Phase 1 disables ASR, AI scoring, generative AI, digital human and RTC; historical media and recording events remain historical-only.
Static contracts, generated types, tests and B26 candidates cannot promote object-store, worker, database, broker, browser or device runtime readiness.

reviewHistory.details: The independent reviewer found zero current-source P1/P2 blockers after checking 14 canonical operations, 30 closed schemas, owner and consent boundaries, fallback cardinality, retry and deletion rules, legacy compatibility, Gateway projection, historical-only events and the fixed M1-008 to M1-009 promotion chain. All conclusions remain D2 and NOT_RUNTIME_VERIFIED.

All M1-009 policy and contract outputs remain D2_CONTRACT_READY / NOT_RUNTIME_VERIFIED. B26 stays static-only, pending and NO-GO; M2-004/005/006 remain incomplete and P1R-M0-006 remains BLOCKED.

P1R-M2-005 remains incomplete and must prove real Kafka topics and ACLs, Outbox publication, consumer dedupe, retry, DLQ/replay, duplicate/disorder/outage/restart behavior and projection rebuilding.
P1R-M2-006 remains incomplete and must prove real workflow task, compensation, manual recovery, reconciliation and immutable audit/closure receipts.

Real transcoding, rendition, waveform and subtitle workers, CDN delivery, browser/device playback and pitch preservation, microphone permission, encrypted local drafts and end-to-end recording flows are not verified by M1-009.

Exact retention duration, export, legal hold and cross-owner purge execution remain owned by P1R-M1-017 and later runtime tasks; M1-009 freezes only policyRef/version and fail-closed receipt semantics.

Candidate media-service events media.asset_*, media.transcoding_updated and media.rendition_updated remain unregistered historical implementation candidates and must not publish before later event/runtime integration.
B26 remains a historical static candidate with runtimeGate=static-only, runtimeStatus=pending and defaultDecision=NO-GO; it is not broker, object-store or production evidence.
